fields.name: name
fields.coerce: a key of `docs.rewards` (docs/directory.js:376-378), then compared with `!= "c0"`
fields.description: The account reward. Only `"c0"` exists: the reward for the tutorial, one roll on the `cosmo0` cosmetics table.

responses.name: Cosmetic
responses.when: The claim succeeded. `exchange` rolls `cosmo0` and adds the cosmetic to your account. It comes before the `player` update.

fields.name: acx
fields.description: All your cosmetics with their counts (`player.p.acx`).

fields.name: bundle
fields.description: `true` when the roll gave a bundle (`cxbundle`) and `name` is the bundle. `cosmo0` has two: `pinkb` and `blackw` (G.drops.cosmo0).

responses.name: Success
responses.when: The claim succeeded, after the `player` update. The claim is asynchronous: it comes after a database transaction.

fields.name: response
fields.description: The code. The object has no `place` and no `success`.

fields.name: rewards
fields.description: All the reward names that the account claimed.

failures.intro: No reply has `place` or `failed`. Some are bare strings.

rows.when: No character, the character is in the bank (`player.user`), `name` is missing, or `docs.rewards[name]` does not exist.
Your character is not verified, or it has no `auth_id`.
`name` is not `"c0"`, or a claim of this character runs already.
Transaction: the account did not finish the tutorial (no user data, or the tutorial is not complete up to its last lesson).
Transaction: the account has this reward already.
The database transaction failed for another reason.

confirm.note: Only on a database error, which a client cannot cause

rows.when: Your character left, or the socket now has another account, when the transaction ends.

confirm.note: `current.owner != owner_id`: the socket has a character of another account now

rows.when: Any other error in the claim.

also.summary: Your character (`u+cid`). The cosmetic is in `acx` on your account, not in your inventory.
